CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, March 19, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE FEBRUARY 19, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  March 19, 2025
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, February 19, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:17 P.M. on Wednesday, February 19, 2025 at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano and Commission Member
Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE NOVEMBER 20, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from President Canseco, the
November 20, 2024 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
No update from the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission at this time.

UTILITY BOX ART PRESENTED BY HALEY HUA
Stella Su represented Tri-Music Honor Society on Haley Hua’s behalf and shared a PowerPoint
presentation to the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission. The Alhambra City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission granted approval to proceed with the caveat of seeking a
muralist advisor for consultation of application and maintenance of the “Echoes of Emotion”
utility box art located at 419 East Hellman Avenue (intersection between East Hellman Avenue
and Almansor Street Overpass) proposed by Mark Keppel High School Tri-M Music Honor
Society.

STAFF REPORT
Director Macias informed the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission that the
annual student art contest to inspire the design of the City of Alhambra’s 2026 Tournament of
Roses float was approved by AUSD and distributed to students by the end of the week. Director
Macias shared imagery of the Alhambra Placemaking Signs at their locations at Alhambra,
Almansor and Granada Park.

The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission approved Christina Ng’s textile art exhibition at
the Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery for July 2025.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
 No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Saunders was informed by Adele Andrade-Stadler, District 5 Councilmember,
that the city received a few complaints about the Moor character’s appearance on the 69 East
Main Street mural. Vice President Saunders responded that the mural sketch was approved by
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission in April 2024 however the Moor
character was not included in their design.

President Canseco and Vice President Saunders discussed the complications of finding an artist
to work within the Alhambra District Art Project budget and concluded to meet with Gallery
Nucleus owner, Ben for artist recommendations.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the February 19,
2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:49 P.M.
